origin.idea: Dynamic strategy driven by a component that recognises chart patterns while they form, instead of a fixed holding horizon.
evidence: S05-momentum-filter-v1 REJECTED (0/3 folds improved, out-of-sample AUC 0.47)
S08 candidate btcusdt-momentum-v1 BLOCKED: -96% net vs +40.5% gross, turnover destroys the edge
origin.data_seen_before_registration: none: the detector was developed and tested on synthetic series only

hypothesis: Long entries taken inside rule-based bullish patterns in formation (double bottom, ascending triangle, bull flag, range), with exits at the pattern's invalidation level or measured-move target and a minimum reward/risk filter, trade rarely enough that the net return after costs (fee 0.10% + slippage 0.05% per side) is positive out of sample and higher than the momentum baseline on the same windows.

inputs.detector: crypto_decision_lab.pattern_detector, DETECTOR_VERSION cdl.e02.pattern-detector.v1; features computed over the whole admitted frame (bars before a window only warm up the detector), reset at every gap

validation.use: one evaluation of the selected configuration

forbidden: BTCUSDT-1h-forward-v1 and any path under data/forward (CP08 reserved)

buy_and_hold.description: constant LONG at max_exposure for the whole window (context only, not a criterion)

selection.rule: On development only: among configurations with closed_trades >= 20, the highest net_return_pct; ties -> fewer closed trades -> grid order. If none qualifies the outcome is INCONCLUSIVE and validation is not run.

outcomes.CANDIDATE: all validation and confirmation criteria pass -> register S08 criteria for a new release and run the S08 flow
outcomes.INCONCLUSIVE: fewer than 15 closed trades on validation, no configuration eligible on development, or validation passes and confirmation fails

checkpoints.check: Detector causality: tests/test_pattern_detector.py green (prefix invariance, current/future bars ignored, gap reset) on the run commit.
Grid of 8 configurations reproducible (same ledger digests on two runs in separate output directories); selection.json written from development only before validation.
report.json per window for baselines and selected configuration with the declared metrics; outcome justified on the criteria.
If CANDIDATE: live config and S08 criteria registered before any S08 evaluation; else closing evidence in the backlog.

threats: Chart patterns have a weak out-of-sample record; the grid is kept small (8) to limit selection bias.
Pivot confirmation delay (pivot_bars) is real latency: entries happen after the pivot is confirmed, never at the extreme.
The strategy holds while any configured pattern is alive, not only the one that triggered the entry.
Validation and confirmation windows were seen by S08 for momentum; they are used once and never for selection.
Patterns are long only: bearish regimes produce no trades, not short profits.
prompt: Lavora esclusivamente sull'esperimento E02 del repository Crypto Decision Lab. Leggi Crypto_Decision_Lab_PRD.md e questa specifica (config/experiments/E02-pattern-formation-v1.json); verifica che il suo sha256 (fine riga LF) coincida con quello registrato nella riga E02 del backlog. Esegui CP-E02.0 (pytest tests/test_pattern_detector.py), poi il comando della specifica due volte in due cartelle di output diverse e confronta i ledger_sha256 (CP-E02.1). Non modificare specifica, detector o strategia dopo aver visto un risultato: ogni modifica richiede una nuova versione preregistrata. Riporta per CP-E02.0-3 comando, atteso, osservato ed evidenza nel formato di handoff del PRD e aggiorna la riga E02 del backlog con l'esito.
